_doc: Large batch L07 (Sonnet generic pass): grey-heron, goliath-heron, pelican-parliament, frigatebird, albatross, fern-cassowary.

grey-heron/f:b0.note: lightning spear-bill: a lightning-fast jab, shock arcs (thrust kept for Spear Beak)

grey-heron/f:b1.note: plunge into reed water: edge ripples

grey-heron/f:u2.note: wading into water is the trick; ripples, confident despite no tag

pelican-parliament/f:b0.note: pouch scoop gulps the prey: jaws

pelican-parliament/f:b1.note: bill plunge into the sea: ripples

pelican-parliament/f:u0.note: pouch scoop that snags (trip): net-like strands, best guess

pelican-parliament/f:u3.note: committee murmur: soft puffs so the four guards are not all shield

frigatebird/f:b0.note: snatch with a hooked beak: jaws

frigatebird/f:u1.note: chase-down swoop: a lance line along the edge

goliath-heron/f:b2.note: plume fan shimmer, avoids a second plain shield; best guess

fern-cassowary/f:b0.note: fern is only the name; a stab is a lance

fern-cassowary/f:u3.note: quick dash: shock; fern only the name
